## Review: Prevent Duplicate Fragment Title for Cloned Cards (Issue #11)

### Executive Summary

The implementation fully satisfies all 7 acceptance criteria from the spec. `generateUniqueFragmentTitle` is added to `MasRepository` with the exact logic specified, `showClone()` correctly pre-fills `titleClone` with the computed unique title before the dialog opens, the template binding is updated from `this.fragment.title` to `this.titleClone`, and `cancelClone()` resets the field to `''`. All 5 unit test cases from the spec are present. Screenshots were skipped because the dev server was not reachable (connection refused on port 9212). Two minor issues were found: an uncommitted test cleanup, and `titleClone` not being registered as a reactive LitElement property.

---

### Issues by Severity

#### tech_debt — Uncommitted cleanup in test file

**Location:** `studio/test/mas-repository.test.js`, lines 1527–1536  
**Description:** The working tree contains an uncommitted diff that removes unused `sandbox` / `sandbox.restore()` declarations from the `generateUniqueFragmentTitle` describe block. The spec-provided test scaffold included a sinon sandbox, but no stubs or spies are created — so it was dead code. The cleanup is correct but needs to be committed.  
**Recommended fix:** Commit the current working-tree change (`git add studio/test/mas-repository.test.js && git commit -m "test(studio): remove unused sinon sandbox from generateUniqueFragmentTitle tests"`).

---

#### tech_debt — `titleClone` not declared as a LitElement reactive property

**Location:** `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`, line 423 (`titleClone = ''`) vs. `static properties` (lines 380–392)  
**Description:** `titleClone` is a plain class field, not in `static properties`. The `value="${this.titleClone}"` template binding works on the first render of the open dialog (because `showCloneDialog = true` triggers the re-render), but any reactive update while the dialog is already open would re-stamp the attribute from the current `titleClone` value — which is kept in sync via the `@input` handler so there is no regression. However, this is an implicit dependency. Note: `tagsClone` and `osiClone` follow the same pattern, so this is consistent with the existing codebase convention, not a new anti-pattern.  
**Recommended fix:** Either leave as-is (consistent with existing pattern) or add `titleClone: { type: String, state: true }` to `static properties` to make the reactivity explicit.

---

#### skippable — Noise commits in history

**Commits:** `b8f9bae` (only `.logs/` files, commit message wrapped in backticks) and `dc862d4` (commit message says "no staged/unstaged changes" but makes no source changes)  
**Description:** Two commits in the feature branch contain no source changes — only untracked `.logs/` directory entries or misleading messages. These do not affect functionality or the PR, but pollute the commit history.  
**Recommended fix:** Squash or drop these before merging via an interactive rebase.

---

### Plan Compliance

| Acceptance Criterion | Status |
|---|---|
| Cloning a duplicate title produces `<base>-1` | ✅ Implemented + tested |
| If `<base>-1` exists, produces `<base>-2` (and so on) | ✅ Implemented + tested |
| Cloning `<base>-N` generates `<base>-(N+1)` or next available | ✅ Implemented + tested |
| Unique title is returned unchanged | ✅ Implemented + tested |
| Original card's Fragment Title not modified | ✅ `generateUniqueFragmentTitle` is read-only |
| Manual edits in clone dialog are not blocked | ✅ `@input` handler still updates `titleClone` freely |
| `cancelClone()` resets `titleClone` to `''` | ✅ Implemented |

All 3 validation commands (`node --check`) pass on `mas-repository.js`, `mas-fragment-editor.js`, and `mas-repository.test.js`.

### Verdict: **PASS** — No blocker issues. Two tech-debt items (uncommitted test cleanup, implicit reactive pattern) and one skippable commit-hygiene note.
